snippet.title: Cat's Vote - Launch Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A resource management game where every decision matters. Manage your family's happiness by balancing limited resources and casting votes in unpredictable feline elections. Will the candidate you choose lower prices, or will their promises lead to chaos?   

Available now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2632940/Cats_Vote/
